exposure: intragesational evaluation methods (non-stress tests, ultrasonic Doppler tests)
cohort: The study reviewed light-for-dates cases among 2113 cause analysis reports issued by the Japan Obstetric Compensation System between January 2009 and September 2018, specifically those involving infants who later developed cerebral palsy.
finding: Non-stress tests and ultrasonic Doppler tests were used to evaluate fetal well-being in cases of FGR, and the study observed cases where additional testing was not performed even when FGR was identified, suggesting that appropriate management of FGR may help reduce the incidence of cerebral palsy.
